mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -2% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 10% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% MoM, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% and INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
